sentences.en: as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.

sentences.en: Okay, there has been a trend that I have been noticing recently, both within myself, but also those around me, across social media, amongst my workmates,
sentences.zh: 好了，我最近注意到了一种趋势，不仅在我自己身上，也在我身边的人、社交媒体上、同事们当中，

sentences.en: even from you guys, the listeners, that everybody is talking about, and that is our collective declining ability to concentrate and our ability to focus.
sentences.zh: 甚至从你们这些听众身上都能看到，大家都在讨论的一个现象，那就是我们集体衰退的注意力和专注能力。

sentences.en: So many of us in this day and age are struggling to stay on task, struggling to keep away from our phones and kind of push back against like the siren call of TikTok and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 在这个时代，我们中的许多人都在挣扎着完成任务，挣扎着远离手机，试图抵抗TikTok和Instagram那种诱人的召唤。

sentences.en: One professor has even stated that our levels of inattention have reached an epidemic rate.
sentences.zh: 一位教授甚至指出，我们注意力不集中的水平已经达到了流行病的程度。

sentences.en: That might sound a little bit extreme, but I think that it's something that all of us can relate to.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能有点极端，但我认为这是我们所有人都能感同身受的。

sentences.en: I want you to seriously ask yourself the simple question of when was the last time you were able to spend a complete hour on a single task without getting distracted?
sentences.zh: 我想让你认真地问自己这样一个简单的问题：你上一次能够心无旁骛地在一项任务上花整整一个小时是在什么时候？

sentences.en: For me, I think for most of us, we probably can't remember that time.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我想对我们大多数人来说，可能已经记不清那个时间了。

sentences.en: It's pretty safe to assume that there has been a gradual decrease in our attention spans going on for some years.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定地说，我们的注意力持续时间在过去几年里一直在逐渐下降。

sentences.en: A lot of us really started noticing it post-COVID and post-lockdown when a lot of us really did get quite engrossed in short-form content on TikTok,
sentences.zh: 许多人在新冠疫情之后和封城期间真正开始注意到这一点，当时我们许多人都深深迷恋上了TikTok上的短视频内容，

sentences.en: when we lacked any structure to our days, when we were allowed to kind of follow any impulse that we had because there was nothing else to do.
sentences.zh: 当时我们的生活没有任何结构，我们可以顺从内心的任何冲动，因为当时无事可做。

sentences.en: That has seemingly bled into where we are now and the consequences of that time and I think a whole number of factors is contributing to our inability to focus
sentences.zh: 这种状况似乎已经渗透到了我们现在的处境中，那个时期的后果以及我认为的大量因素共同导致了我们无法专注于

sentences.en: and concentrate for a sustained period of time.
sentences.zh: 并持续保持集中的状态。

sentences.en: The area I think we notice it most is when it comes to those kind of activities that require us to be concentrated for some time.
sentences.zh: 我们最常注意到这一点的领域，是那些需要我们集中精力一段时间的活动。

sentences.en: So I'm going to say more than an hour at least, but where there are little short-term consequences if we don't stay focused.

sentences.en: only to find yourself a few minutes later drawn back into some other task or some other source of entertainment.

sentences.en: I think that is the area where a lot of us are noticing this occurring.

sentences.en: So let's quickly get up to speed on some of the basics of attention.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来快速了解一些关于注意力的基础知识。

sentences.en: We tend to think of attention as being only one thing, the ability to focus on one specific task for a continuous period of time without being distracted.
sentences.zh: 我们往往认为注意力只有一种，即在没有分心的情况下，连续一段时间专注于一项特定任务的能力。

sentences.en: And it's something that's in our control.
sentences.zh: 而且这是在我们控制之中的。

sentences.en: What we're talking about when we talk about a controlled, sustained period of focus is actually only one form of attention
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论这种受控的、持续的专注期时，实际上它只是注意力的一种形式，

sentences.en: called sustained attention.
sentences.zh: 被称为持续注意力。

sentences.en: We also have selective attention where there are multiple stimuli and things going on in the environment and we have to choose to focus on just one and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们还有选择性注意力，即环境中存在多种刺激和事物，我们必须选择只专注于其中一个，并且，你知道的，

sentences.en: tune in or filter out the other distractions.
sentences.zh: 调动注意力或过滤掉其他干扰。

sentences.en: And then we have alternating attention.
sentences.zh: 然后我们有交替注意力。

sentences.en: This is also known as multitasking where we switch back and forth between tasks that have different cognitive demands.
sentences.zh: 这也称为多任务处理，我们在具有不同认知需求的任务之间来回切换。

sentences.en: So this might sound efficient, right?
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能很高效，对吧？

sentences.en: You're writing your essay whilst also listening to a lecture or you're texting and driving.
sentences.zh: 你一边写论文一边听讲座，或者你一边发短信一边开车。

sentences.en: That's the classic one.
sentences.zh: 这是最典型的一个例子。

sentences.en: But study after study will tell you that when you're performing two or more tasks at once, especially ones that are cognitively demanding and splitting up your focus,
sentences.zh: 但一项又一项的研究会告诉你，当你同时执行两项或多项任务时，尤其是那些需要高认知需求并分散你注意力的任务，

sentences.en: this will actually lead to lower efficiency on both tasks.
sentences.zh: 这实际上会导致两项任务的效率都降低。

sentences.en: It makes us sloppier, it increases our stress, but also, I think I can speak from experience, it takes so much more time than if you've just done each thing, you know,
sentences.zh: 这会让我们变得更粗心，增加我们的压力，而且，我想我可以根据经验说，它比你把每件事情做完，

sentences.en: one after the other and consecutively.
sentences.zh: 一个接一个、连续地完成要花费多得多的时间。

sentences.en: So that is alternating attention and the final kind of attention we have is divided attention and this is very similar to alternating.
sentences.zh: 这就是交替注意力，我们拥有的最后一种注意力是分散注意力，这与交替注意力非常相似。

sentences.en: It basically highlights our ability to react to two or more different demands or things in our environment simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 它基本上突出了我们同时对环境中两种或多种不同需求或事物做出反应的能力。

sentences.en: So this kind of attention, dividing attention, it's just less cognitively demanding.
sentences.zh: 所以这种注意力，即分散注意力，它的认知需求较小。

sentences.en: It basically is, you know, your ability to watch
sentences.zh: 它基本上就是，你知道的，你一边看

sentences.en: TV whilst also eating.
sentences.zh: 电视一边吃东西的能力。
